story.fullStory:
Post Malone's "I Had Some Help" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "I Had Some Help" is a song by American musician Post Malone featuring American country music singer Morgan Wallen.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 67 weeks on the chart.

I Had Some Help was released in 2024.

"I Had Some Help" is a song by American musician Post Malone featuring American country music singer Morgan Wallen.
It was released through Republic and Mercury Records as the lead single from Malone's sixth studio album, F-1 Trillion, on May 10, 2024.
They wrote the song with producers Louis Bell, Charlie Handsome, and Hoskins, alongside Ernest, Ashley Gorley, and Chandler Paul Walters.
